name: Operation Athena
storyline: It's the 2020s, a terrorist network known as “OPHID” has been funded by world governments such as the CCP, The Russian Federation and others. OPHID has begun ramping up their attacks across the globe, including the United States. OPHID is no longer an enemy hiding in the shadows. Tier 1 operators across the globe have been selected to participate in and join “Athena Team”, an extremely covert and sophisticated fighting force. As a member of Athena Team you have been tasked with locating, and destroying members of OPHID. Participate in Operations across the globe, From extracting members of world government who have been taken hostage, to raiding training grounds.
summary: Operation Athena is a tactical first person shooter that takes inspiration from classic tactical shooters with updated modern mechanics. Take part as an operator of Athena Team solo or with up to 4 players against a global terrorist threat.
